title: Measuring and Recording Receivables at Net Amount Expected to Be Collected

items.concept: Initial recognition of AR from credit sales; subsequent measurement via AR/AFDA schedules and aging of receivables under CECL; period-end adjusting JE to desired allowance; settlement write-off and recovery JEs; BS presentation at net amount expected to be collected

Number-variant twin: credit sales initial recognition; AR/AFDA subsequent measurement schedules; aging-based desired allowance; period-end adjust when unadjusted AFDA is a debit; write-off and recovery settlement

Period-end adjusting JE using a single expected credit loss rate on total receivables; first-year establishment of the allowance; multi-period AFDA schedule; demonstration that write-offs do not change net AR; recovery settlement
Classification of write-off effects under the allowance method; measurement objective of CECL (net amount expected to be collected)
